systems.system: National Backbone Fiber Optic Cable Network and Communication Service Project
systems.country_label: National Backbone Optical Cable Network and Communication Service Project
systems.platform: more than 2,275 km of fibre on three sections (Niamey-Tillabery, Zinder-Diffa, Agadez-Tahoua), with 136 GSM and WCDMA terminals, CDMA and ADSL networks and e-government services
systems.owner: Government of Niger; SONITEL, the state operator, responsible for repaying the China Eximbank loan
systems.tiers: national; no local government office said to be on it

note: A deal record for the China Eximbank loan of 2 January 2014 for the national fibre backbone, built June 2015 to the first quarter of 2017; 'handed over to the local authorities' means the Nigerien authorities, and no local government office is said to be connected.
